name: @textfilters/profanity
description: Dictionary-agnostic TypeScript profanity runtime with reusable indexes, source ranges, obfuscation handling, and allow-range exclusions.

scripts.lint: prettier README.md package.json src tests scripts --check
scripts.format: prettier README.md package.json src tests scripts --write
scripts.smoke:dist: npm run build && node --input-type=module --eval "const { createProfanityFilter } = await import('./dist/index.js'); const filter = createProfanityFilter({ id: 'smoke', deny: ['blocked'], allow: [] }); if (!filter.check('blocked')) throw new Error('Smoke check failed');"
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run smoke:dist && npm run pack:dry-run
scripts.benchmark:profanity: npm run build --workspace @textfilters/core && node ../../scripts/build-profanity-dictionary.mjs && npm run build && node --expose-gc scripts/benchmark-profanity.mjs
